feeds.title: Rachel Got Hamsters
feeds.description: Rachel Got Hamsters is a heartfelt and highly practical blog by Rachel, documenting her journey as a hamster owner from impulsively adopting her first hamster in 2020 to becoming a seasoned caretaker with a rotating cast of rescue hamsters.

feeds.title: Hamster Insider
feeds.description: Hamster Insider is a comprehensive online resource designed to support both new and experienced hamster owners with research-backed insights, expert care guides, and community-focused updates ensuring your furry buddy thrives in a safe and healthy environment.

feeds.title: Cunipic Blog » Hamsters
feeds.description: In our blog for hamsters you will find everything you were looking for about food, care, advice, health, as well as news of interest.

feeds.title: Happy Hamstery Blog
feeds.description: Happy Hamstery's news page is a section where they share updates related to their hamstery and small pet care. The page is set up like a blog but currently shows only the header and structure without many visible recent posts, suggesting it is used for occasional updates rather than regular articles.

feeds.title: Hamster Care
feeds.description: Hamster Care is your go-to hamster blog site to get the most accurate and updated information about caring for your hamster. Our goal is to provide information to the hamster owners and guide them on how to provide ethical care to pet hamsters.

feeds.title: HamsterWelfare.com Blog
feeds.description: A selection of the latest hamster news and Interesting stories. Hamsterwelfare.com is here to bring together the advice, evidence, and care information from the most reputable sources available.

feeds.title: Hamster Home Blog
feeds.description: Hi! My name is Sofia, I have 2 children and I am a hamster enthusiast, animal lover, and blogger. I have had five hamsters in my life, each with its own personality! I've been a hamster enthusiast for as long as I can remember. My friends and family know me as the one to turn to when they have a problem with their pet rodents.

feeds.title: Hamsters Blog
feeds.description: Hamsters are top-of-the-line pets, especially as the children's first pet. Its temperament and calm nature are usually claimed to be responsible for its popularity but the list does not end here.

feeds.title: Hamsteropedia Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our growing encyclopedia of hamster care knowledge. You are a loving hamster owner, and so are we! On our blog, you'll find thoroughly vetted information about hamster care, common behaviors, eating preferences, and fun activities you can do with your furry buddy.

feeds.title: Hamsters
feeds.description: Hi Tara here, mistress of this blog. I have been handling hamsters since 2009. Do enjoy yourselves on this blog, Cheers!

feeds.title: Hamster Helper Blog
feeds.description: Well researched trustworthy information about hamster care. It's time to end the mis-information about hamsters so they can get better care.

feeds.title: Squeaks and Nibbles » Hamster
feeds.description: Squeaks and Nibbles is a multi-pet care blog from Red Cat Media Ltd, featuring expert-written guides on hamsters along with other small pet.

feeds.title: Kiddly Fun Blog
feeds.description: The HamsterUse blog shares simple, beginner-friendly guides on hamster care. It covers daily routines, feeding, handling, health tips, preventing common problems, and understanding different hamster breeds. The posts focus on helping new owners keep their hamsters healthy, comfortable, and stress-free with practical advice written in an easy, helpful tone.

feeds.title: LittleGrabbies
feeds.description: LittleGrabbies is a small pet care blog run by an individual who shares practical guides on hamsters, rabbits, guinea pigs, and other small animals. The site focuses on simple, clear advice about housing, diet, behavior, and enrichment.

feeds.title: Hamsters101.com
feeds.description: If you're looking for hamster care tips, health, and nutrition info, clues about your hammy's behavior, or just fun hamster facts and trivia - you've come to the right place!

feeds.title: Hamster Guru Blog
feeds.description: Read our Hamster Guru blog where we share answers to frequently asked questions and how-to guides relating to all things hamsters! We love hamsters! As a family with 2 children, a hamster was the perfect first pet for us. We have an adorable Syrian hamster called Oscar who is now very tame. He is well-handled every day and looked after by our daughters.

feeds.title: Cats and Hamsters Blog
feeds.description: Cats and Hamsters is a pet-sitting blog based in Montreal that shares practical care advice for cats and small pets, including hamsters. It features hands-on tips from real pet-sitting experience, such as cleaning and maintaining water bottles and daily care routines. useful guidance focused on keeping small pets healthy and comfortable.
